command: uv run --frozen --project harness python scripts/s3/sqlfluffrs_probe.py fixtures --scratch $SCRATCH

checks.exact: suites/dialects.run: compare.trees_match of the fixture tree (compare.load_yaml) and the probe tree (compare.record_to_tuple). The probe gives the code-only tree for a .yml case (--code-only).
checks.no_unparsable: a tree, no unparsable node, no error, exit code 0
checks.exact_harness_filter: the same, with the full probe tree and the harness filter (code_only.code_only_record), as for sqruff
